bio:
Ellen C. Fuller was born on 16 April 1830, the daughter of Isaac Fuller of Huntsville, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, and Nancy Bulkeley Worthington, who was born at Colchester, Connecticut, on 1 July 1792. Through Nancy's mother, Mary Adams Bulkeley, Ellen descended from Lieutenant Colonel Eliphalet Bulkeley of the 25th Connecticut Militia and, further back, from the Puritan minister Rev. Peter Bulkeley of Concord, Massachusetts.

On 3 December 1848 she married David Nesbitt of Plymouth, who died on 14 July 1862 leaving her with four children. In April 1864 she married again, to Jacob Pringle of Plymouth, son of Benjamin and Charity (Gould) Pringle. She died at Plymouth on 9 September 1898, and her will was registered in Plymouth Borough that year.
